podcast.title: Concert at 42,080 Feet (2010)
podcast.body: On June 28, 2010, James Blunt performed a concert on a Boeing 767 that took off from Stansted Airport in England. The plane reached a height of 42,080 feet during his performance, setting a new record for the highest gig, approximately two miles higher than the previous record held by Jamiroquai. "He played a gig on June 28, 2010, on a Boeing 767 that took off from Stanstead Airport in England to a height of 42,080 feet."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Ibiza Neighbor Incident
podcast.body: James Blunt's purchase of a house adjacent to Noel Gallagher's property in Ibiza directly led to Noel Gallagher selling his own house. Noel stated he "couldn't stand being his neighbor." "la de lado la covia comprado James Blunt y no soportaba ser el vecino de James Blunt."
